newsitem.title: USA: Planned IMF Latvia loan likely to be for $45 mln.
newsitem.headline: Planned IMF Latvia loan likely to be for $45 mln.

text.p: The International Monetary Fund is likely to lend Latvia $45 million under an 18-month standby arrangement agreed earlier this week, international monetary sources said on Thursday.
Finance Minister Robert Zile gave no figure for the loan when he said on Tuesday that agreement had been reached. He said the loan was likely to be signed in September.

A previous standby deal for the Baltic state expires in August. IMF mission head Emmanuel van der Mensbrughe said on Tuesday that the focus of Latvian economic policy would shift to structural reform under the new loan in order to ensure that economic development was sustainable.
